drop.name: stake_token_sync
drop.why: over-claims: anyone can send stake tokens straight to A0 with MockToken_STK.transfer, changing the held balance without a booked stake; correct behaviour trips it. staked_backed covers the real property

fix.name: harvest_bounded
fix.expr: ok and not called("notifyReward") and not called("MockToken_RWD.transferFrom") and not called("MockToken_RWD.transfer") and wide(post("MockToken_RWD.balanceOf", sender) - pre("MockToken_RWD.balanceOf", sender)) > wide(pre("userInfo", sender, "amount")) * wide(pre("accRewardPerShare")) // 1000000000000 - pre("userInfo", sender, "rewardDebt")
fix.why: a pool call pays at most the caller's pending reward; direct reward-token transfers/transferFrom to the caller are unrelated and excluded

fix.name: rewards_out_only_to_sender
fix.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and not called("MockToken_RWD.transferFrom") and post("MockToken_RWD.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken_RWD.balanceOf", u)
fix.why: no reward token loss for others (excluding legitimate transferFrom by an approved spender)

fix.name: stake_token_no_third_party
fix.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and u != A3 and not called("MockToken_STK.transferFrom") and post("MockToken_STK.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken_STK.balanceOf", u)
fix.why: no stake token loss for others (excluding legitimate transferFrom by an approved spender)

add.name: import_receives_tokens
add.expr: ok and called("importLegacy") and post("MockToken_STK.balanceOf", A0) - pre("MockToken_STK.balanceOf", A0) != post("userInfo", sender, "amount") - pre("userInfo", sender, "amount")
add.why: imported stake is credited only for stake tokens actually received

add.name: import_no_reward_windfall
add.expr: ok and called("importLegacy") and wide(post("userInfo", sender, "amount")) * wide(post("accRewardPerShare")) // 1000000000000 - post("userInfo", sender, "rewardDebt") > wide(pre("userInfo", sender, "amount")) * wide(pre("accRewardPerShare")) // 1000000000000 - pre("userInfo", sender, "rewardDebt")
add.why: adding stake must not create pending rewards for the past
